lines.text: @samurai is the samurai who does all the cleaning work for you. He sweeps the hall in one clean arc and folds the laundry into sharp squares.
Quick cuts, each task one strike.

new_beats.text: @samurai slices a sponge through a stack of dishes, and every plate gleams.

writes.note: I added one beat where @samurai finishes the dishes in a single stroke.

reply.rationale: The shot covers sweeping and laundry but not dishes, so I added one timed moment that fits the one-strike-per-task direction and keeps the existing words unchanged.
